summary.note: 22 DefiLlama registry asset identities (20 symbols; USDV and USDS tickers each span multiple identities; BUIDL includes the BUIDL-I share class address) have direct on-chain supply observations across two 2026-09-12 cohorts. Cohort 1 (12 identities, 11 symbols) staged unsigned; cohort 2 (10 identities) observed 15:40-15:45Z, not yet staged. RLUSD remains the one signed/rooted identity. 403 identities have no deep supply observation.
